confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for a small Ionian coastal resort town, not checked against live listings or menus. July is peak season, so accommodation and drink anchors carry the widest uncertainty. The FX observation comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not read that page directly, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Albanian coastal resort towns and Ionian/Greek tourist towns with similar July demand, adjusted down for Albania's lower general price levels. No specific named listings or web sources were used for the city anchors.
